$comment: Compliance registry — the single source of truth for whether a partner's terms have been reviewed and what restrictions apply. Every partner that has ever been reviewed (active, pending, or reviewed-but-not-applied) gets an entry here, even if nothing from that partner is live yet — this is a record of terms review, not a list of live partners. lib/partner-compliance.ts reads this file to gate every import (scripts/import-partner.mjs) and every render of partner data on the live site. Update this file whenever new terms are reviewed or a partner's status changes — nothing else needs to change for the gate to pick it up.

brooklyn-delhi.imageUsageNote: No branding guidelines in partner terms; content use is encouraged. Proceeding with attribution based on terms language and risk assessment — written confirmation from Malika has not been received yet.

evdance.imageUsageNote: Checked directly via AWIN's advertiser terms page (ui.awin.com/merchant-profile-terms/67740) — every section (Branding, Publishers, PPC, Transactions, De-Duplication) is either unanswered or contains no image/content/branding usage language at all; Branding tab holds only generic program-overview marketing copy, not usage rules. This is genuine silence, not explicit permission — no restriction was found, but none was granted either. Proceeding assessed-low-risk on that basis, same treatment as Brooklyn Delhi. Revisit if EVDANCE ever publishes real terms.
